affected_boundaries: Git certificate freshness to immutable plan parse-cache identity

observed_behavior: Git certificate inputs were treated as legacy hash arrays; dependency collection caught the resulting map error and stored a constant invalid signature.
expected_behavior: Changes to certified inputs invalidate the plan parse cache.
causal_mechanism: The collector assumes every input contract is an array, although Git inputs are a revision/paths object. Its caught error hides subsequent dependency changes.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Read one physical input variant using another variant shape.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: The error signature remains unchanged as certified source inputs change.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Every input variant contributes its actual semantic freshness dependencies.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Use the canonical Git-input discriminator and freshness checker, deduplicate identical input sets, and include artifact availability.

applicability_conditions: Plan index contains certificates using the Git input variant.
known_non_matches: Legacy hash-array inputs remain valid under their existing contract.
confirmation_evidence: Collector calls map on an object Git-input variant.
Regression changes a certified source, observes a new parse identity, and restores the original identity when source content is restored.
regression_proofs: tests/project-index.test.js: plan parse cache tracks Git certificate input freshness without treating Git inputs as hash arrays
